description_en: Invoke this API to continuously perform grayscale migration for newly added devices.
description_zh: 调用该接口持续灰度迁移新增设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-gray-migration-device --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-names example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGrayMigrationDevice

parameters.description_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.
parameters.help_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.description_en:
The list of device names to be grayscale migrated.  

You can specify up to 10 device names in a single API call. Any device names beyond 10 will be discarded directly.
parameters.description_zh:
待灰度迁移的设备名称列表。

单次调用本接口，最多传入10个设备名称。超出10个的设备名称会被直接丢弃。
